Akhilesh Yadav Criticizes BJP Over Saharanpur Mosque Demolition

Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of creating a communal atmosphere for political gain following the demolition of a mosque in Saharanpur. Yadav questioned the necessity and speed of the demolition, which he stated occurred within 12 hours. He also commented on the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) for public good in sectors like healthcare, agriculture, and weather prediction.
